scope: Whole original slider writer, physical/normalized wrappers, numeric formatter and SSO lifetime execute. Exact identity curve is an explicit ABI service; GUI lookup/count and terminal setter/signals are supplied observers. Real C-locale UCRT roundf/strtof/vsprintf services, owned errno bookkeeping. Compares stored normalized arguments, mapped/normalized/id-value signals, index updates and raw view-space return. Finite supplied metadata, precision0..6/negative auto, representable CVTT, serial no-exception valid profile. Arbitrary concrete curves, constructors, actual GUI/controller delivery, source error behavior, physical touch and full UI/pixel parity remain separate. Public fixture contains synthetic metadata only.
locale_policy: Windows uses isolated actual UCRT locale with direct locale-specific formatting/parsing; POSIX scopes a C numeric locale to the calling thread and restores it. No global locale modification.
android_status: Configured for remote Linux/Android builds and emulator; new writer runtime pending.
